text.lead: Heartlock is a 2019 American romantic crime drama film directed by Jon Kauffman and starring Alexander Dreymon, Lesley-Ann Brandt and Erik LaRay Harvey. It is Kauffman's feature directorial debut.
text.cast:
- Alexander Dreymon
- Lesley-Ann Brandt
- Erik LaRay Harvey
- Cedric Young
- Wayne David Parker
- Javon Anderson
text.release: The film was released in theaters in the United States and on VOD on January 25, 2019.
text.reception:
The film has a 40% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Asher Luberto of Film Threat awarded the film a 4 out of 10.
Frank Scheck of The Hollywood Reporter gave the film a negative review and wrote that "this indie drama simply lacks the necessary cinematic tension. Despite fine performances from its lead performers, the film never fully comes to life."
